source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 7 exercise solved (PDF 178-179), MCQ keys worked out from the chapter, model answers for every question.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Structural and Computational Biology) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Generally, the function of a protein depends on its:
(Aam tor par protein ka kaam (function) us ki kis cheez par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Protein ka kaam us ki sahi folding (tah lagne) se bani three-dimensional (3D) shape par munhasir hai. 3D structure hi active sites aur domains dikhata hai (7.1).

blocks.prompt:
2. The protein domains are:
(Protein domains kya hain?)

options.text: Protein ke andar functional aur structural units

blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq domains protein ke alag structural units hain jin ka apna (independent) kaam hota hai, maslan HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ka polymerase domain aur RNase H domain (7.1).

blocks.prompt:
3. The first step in x-ray crystallography experiment is:
(X-ray crystallography experiment ka pehla qadam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehla qadam protein crystallization hai, yaani saaf (purified) protein ka crystal banana. Phir diffraction pattern, phir density map aur aakhir mein structure (7.2).

blocks.prompt:
4. What is primary role of computational biology?
(Computational biology ka bunyadi kaam kya hai?)

options.text: Computer algorithms se data ka analysis karna

blocks.explanation: Computational biology computer ki techniques aur tools se biological data ka analysis aur tashreeh (interpretation) karti hai (7.3). Baqi options is ke sirf kuch istemal hain.

blocks.prompt:
5. Which computational approach is used to predict protein structure based on amino acid sequence?
(Amino acid sequence se protein structure ka andaza lagane ke liye kaun sa computational tareeqa istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Homology modelling mein na-maloom sequence ko maloom structure wale template protein ke saath align kar ke computed structure model banaya jata hai (Fig. 7.7). BLAST sirf milti julti sequences dhoondta hai, structure nahi banata.

blocks.prompt:
1. Define domains of the protein.
Protein ke domains ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation: Domains protein ke alag structural units hain jin ka apna alag (independent) kaam hota hai. Misal: HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ka polymerase domain DNA banata hai aur RNase H domain RNA-DNA hybrid ka RNA strand torta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. How corona virus enters the host cells?
Corona virus host cells mein kaise dakhil hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) ki surface par spike proteins bahar nikle hote hain. Spike protein insani cell ki membrane par maujood receptor protein ACE2 se jur (bind) jata hai. Is binding se virus cell mein dakhil ho kar apni copies banata (replicate karta) hai aur ACE2 ka normal kaam bhi ruk jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Define genomics.
Genomics ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation: Genomics genomes ka mutala hai; genome kisi organism ke ek cell ka poora DNA set hota hai. Is mein genome ki sequencing, assembling aur us ki structure aur function ka analysis hota hai; is se genetic variations, genes ke kaam aur evolutionary rishte samajh aate hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Differentiate between genomics and proteomics.
Genomics aur proteomics mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono computational biology ke bare shobe hain: genomics poore DNA (genome) ko parhti hai, proteomics tamam proteins (proteome) ko.

rows: Genomes ka mutala (cell ka poora DNA)
Proteins ka bare paimane par mutala (proteome)
Genome ki sequencing, assembling aur analysis
Organism ke tamam proteins ka naqsha (map) banana
Proteins ki structure, function, interactions aur kirdar
Genetic variations, gene function aur evolution samajhne mein madad
Cell ke processes mein proteins ka kirdar samajhne mein madad

blocks.prompt:
5. What is GenBank. Describe it briefly.
GenBank kya hai? Mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: GenBank (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nuccore/) nucleotide sequences ka ek bara public database hai jis mein un ki bibliographic aur biological maloomat (annotations) bhi hoti hain. Is mein mukhtalif organisms ki DNA sequences ka bara zakheera hai jo genetic research aur comparative genomics (genomes ka muqabla) mein kaam aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Write a short note on protein data bank.
Protein Data Bank par mukhtasar note likhein.
blocks.explanation: Protein Data Bank (PDB) bare biological molecules (proteins aur nucleic acids) ke 3D structures ka database hai. Is se macromolecules ki structure aur kaam samjhe jate hain aur aisi dawaiyan design ki jati hain jo khaas protein structures ko nishana (target) banayein.

blocks.prompt:
1. Describe the applications of structural biology.
Structural biology ke istemal (applications) bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Structural biology macromolecules (proteins aur nucleic acids) ke three-dimensional (3D) structures ka atomic level par mutala hai. Is ke khaas istemal, khaas kar medical research mein:
1. Active sites aur domains maloom karna: 3D structure se active site aur domains ki jagah, shape aur mahaul maloom hota hai. Misal: HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ke polymerase aur RNase H domains pehchane gaye, jin se antiviral dawaiyan banin; serine protease ka active site peptide bonds torta hai.
2. Drug targets pehchanna: bimari paida karne wale protein ki 3D shape se woh jagah milti hai jahan dawai jur kar protein ko rok sake. Misal: SARS-CoV-2 ka spike protein drug target bana aur us ko rokne wali vaccines aur dawaiyan banin.
3. Host-pathogen interaction samajhna: pathogen (jaraseem) aur host ke proteins ke 3D structures se pata chalta hai ke pathogen cell se kaise judta aur andar jata hai. Misal: spike protein ACE2 receptor se judta hai; receptor se judne wali dawai virus ka dakhla rok deti hai.
4. Protein misfolding samajhna: protein ka kaam sahi folding par hai. Cystic fibrosis, Parkinson's aur Alzheimer's ghalat folding (misfolding) se hoti hain; structural biology folding ke raste aur misfolding se bimari ka tareeqa samjhati hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Write a note on principle and working of x-ray crystallography.
X-ray crystallography ke usool (principle) aur kaam ke tareeqe par note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
X-ray crystallography 1912 mein William Henry Bragg aur William Lawrence Bragg ne banai (1915 Physics Nobel Prize). Is se minerals, salts, metals, proteins, carbohydrates, nucleic acids aur vitamins ka structure parha jata hai.
Usool (principle): X-ray beam crystal par parti hai; crystal ke atoms beam ko khaas simton mein diffract (mor) karte hain. Diffract hui beams ke angles aur shiddat (intensity) se crystal ki electron density ki 3D tasveer banti hai, aur us se molecule ka 3D structure banaya jata hai.
Kaam ka tareeqa (protein ki misal):
(i) Protein crystallization: saaf protein ko khaas solutions mein ahista mila kar us ke molecules ko baqaida dohrate pattern (crystal) mein jamaya jata hai; ghanton se hafton tak lagte hain; temperature, pH aur namak ki miqdar control karni parti hai.
(ii) Diffraction pattern banana: crystal X-ray machine par laga kar mukhtalif angles se X-rays dali jati hain; atoms X-rays ko diffract karte hain aur detector par dhabbon (spots) ka pattern banta hai.
(iii) Density map banana: spots ke angles aur intensities atoms ki tarteeb batate hain; in se electron density map banta hai.
(iv) Protein structure maloom karna: computer programs data ko hisabi (mathematical) tor par hal kar ke protein ka 3D structure (model) banate hain.
Tarteeb (Fig. 7.3): X-rays → crystal → diffraction → detector → computer + graphics → electron density map → protein model.

blocks.prompt:
3. Briefly describe key databases of computational biology.
Computational biology ke ahem databases mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Computational biology nucleic acids aur proteins ka data online databases mein rakhti aur parhti hai. Ahem databases:
1. GenBank (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nuccore/): nucleotide sequences ka bara public database, annotations (maloomat) ke saath. Mukhtalif organisms ki DNA sequences deta hai; genetic research aur comparative genomics mein madadgar.
2. Protein Data Bank (PDB): proteins aur nucleic acids jaise bare molecules ka 3D structural data deta hai; structure aur kaam samajhne aur khaas proteins ko target karne wali dawaiyan design karne mein kaam aata hai.
3. Ensembl: genome browser jo mukhtalif species ki genome sequences, gene models aur comparative genomics ki maloomat deta hai; genomic data dekhne (visualize) aur evolution ki study mein madad deta hai.
In databases ko BLAST (protein ya DNA sequences ka muqabla kar ke homologous sequences dhoondna) aur FASTA (query sequence ko database se mila kar mushabihat ke hisse dhoondna) jaise algorithms se search kiya jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. Consider there is a pandemic of a new unknown disease, and the causative agent is a virus. You also know that virus belongs to X family. How structural biology can be helpful in preventing the disease?
Farz karein ek nai na-maloom bimari ki waba (pandemic) hai jis ka sabab ek virus hai jo X family se hai. Structural biology is bimari se bachao mein kaise madad kar sakti hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Virus ki surface protein (spike jaisi) ka 3D structure X-ray crystallography se maloom karein, ya X family ke maloom protein ko template bana kar homology modelling se andaza lagayein.
2. Host-pathogen interaction dekhein: viral protein host ke kis receptor se judta hai (jaise SARS-CoV-2 ka spike ACE2 se) aur virus cell mein kaise jata hai.
3. Drug targets pehchanein: viral protein ki binding site aur us ke ahem enzymes ke active sites (jaise HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ke domains).
4. Vaccine banayein jo jism ko surface protein pehchanna aur rokna sikhaye, aur aisi dawai jo target site ya host receptor mein fit ho kar virus ka dakhla ya copies banana rok de.
5. X family ke doosre viruses ki pehle se maloom dawaiyan jaldi test ki ja sakti hain, kyun ke rishtedar proteins ke structures milte julte hote hain (structural homology).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Asal nukta: bimari rokne ke liye pehle virus ke protein ki shape (3D structure) jaanni zaroori hai; shape maloom ho to us ko rokne wali vaccine ya dawai banai ja sakti hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Suppose you find an unknown protein and determine amino acid sequence by Edman degradation/mass spectrometry. How you can exploit the computational biology to predict the structure and function of the protein.
Farz karein aap ko ek na-maloom protein milta hai aur Edman degradation/mass spectrometry se us ki amino acid sequence maloom hoti hai. Computational biology se us ka structure aur function kaise maloom karenge?
blocks.explanation:
1. Sequence ko BLAST ya FASTA se databases (GenBank, PDB) mein search karein taake maloom proteins ki homologous (hum-asal) sequences mil jayein.
2. Function: agar na-maloom protein kisi maloom kaam wale protein se homologous hai to us ka kaam bhi milta julta hoga (sequence homology); doosri species ke orthologs aksar wohi kaam rakhte hain.
3. Structure: PDB mein maloom 3D structure wala homologous protein template banayein, sequences align karein aur homology modelling se computed structure model banayein (Fig. 7.7).
4. Model se domains aur active site ka andaza lagayein; milte julte structure wale proteins aksar milta julta kaam karte hain (structural homology), is se function ki tasdeeq hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Homology models of macromolecules differ from experimentally determined structures of the macromolecules. Please comment.
Macromolecules ke homology models tajurbe (experiment) se maloom kiye gaye structures se mukhtalif hote hain. Tabsira karein.
blocks.explanation:
Haan. Experiment se maloom structure (maslan X-ray crystallography) asal molecule se aata hai: usi ke crystal se diffraction pattern aur electron density map bante hain, is liye atoms ki asal jagah maloom hoti hai.
Homology model sirf andaza (prediction) hai: na-maloom sequence ko maloom structure wale template ke saath align kar ke model compute kiya jata hai (Fig. 7.7); farz kiya jata hai ke protein apne homologue jaisa fold hoga.
Is liye model utna hi sahi hai jitna template aur alignment: jahan sequences mukhtalif hon (zaid ya badli hui amino acids, loops, active site ki tafseel) wahan model asal se mukhtalif ho sakta hai. Mushabihat zyada ho to model asal ke qareeb hota hai, kam ho to ghalti zyada (beyond the chapter). Homology model jaldi aur sasta hai aur jab crystal na ban sake tab kaam aata hai, lekin experimental structure zyada qabil-e-bharosa hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Draw a flow chart to describe the steps involved in drug development till its prescription.
Dawai banane (drug development) se le kar doctor ke nuskhe (prescription) tak ke marahil ka flow chart banayein.
blocks.explanation:
Marahil ko boxes mein likh kar neeche ki taraf teeron (arrows) se jorein (drug target ke baad ke marahil chapter se bahar hain, beyond the chapter):
1. [Box] Bimari aur us ki wajah (pathogen ya kharab protein) pehchanna.
↓
2. [Box] Drug target pehchanna: target protein ka 3D structure (X-ray crystallography / homology modelling) aur us ki active ya binding site.
↓
3. [Box] Dawai ke molecules design karna: computational biology andaza lagati hai ke kaun sa molecule target se judega (drug discovery); behtareen molecules chunna.
↓
4. [Box] Preclinical testing: lab mein cells aur janwaron par asar aur hifazat (toxicity, zehreela pan) ki jaanch.
↓
5. [Box] Insanon par clinical trials: Phase I (sehatmand logon ke chhote group mein safety) → Phase II (mareezon ke chhote group mein asar aur dose) → Phase III (mareezon ke bare group mein, purane ilaj se muqabla).
↓
6. [Box] Drug regulatory authority se manzoori (licence/registration).
↓
7. [Box] Dawai ki tayyari (manufacturing) aur market mein aana.
↓
8. [Box] Doctor ka mareez ko dawai likhna (prescription), aur side effects ki nigrani jari (Phase IV).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter sirf pehle teen marahil (target pehchanna, 3D structure, computational drug discovery) batata hai. Preclinical, clinical trials aur approval aam maloomat hain jo flow chart mukammal karne ke liye di gayi hain.

items: Short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab har sawal ke saath diye gaye hain. Inquisitive 3 aur 4 mein chapter se bahar ki baatein "(beyond the chapter)" likh kar batayi gayi hain.
